thesis: Evaluate agricultural advice at model, system, and process levels; no single score substitutes for farmer agency or demonstrated outcomes.

research_anchors.name: Beyond the model: Evaluating AI agricultural advisory systems so they work in the field
research_anchors.relevance: Recommends complementary model-, system-, and process-level evaluation including usability, trust, reliability, expert roles, and equity.

research_anchors.name: Field-Ready HCI: A Conceptual Model of Mobile Application Use in Agriculture for Low-Resource and Smallholder Contexts
research_anchors.relevance: Frames local language, low literacy, offline operation, explainable advice, trust and farmer networks as field-readiness dimensions.

research_anchors.name: Not-so-digital platforms? Non-use, (in)appropriate technologies, and offline dimensions of digital agricultural services for smallholders in rural Africa
research_anchors.relevance: Finds registration can conceal limited or short-lived use in studied settings; warns about socio-technical misfit and emphasizes existing peer, extension and low-tech channels.

research_anchors.name: ICT-Based Versus Human-Based Climate Information: Implications for Agronomic Decisions Among Smallholder Farmers in the Eastern Cape, South Africa
research_anchors.relevance: Motivates locally comparing digital climate information and human-mediated advice; its sample/context are not transferable as universal estimates.

claim_boundary: A model oracle pass is not usability evidence. A usable prototype is not field validation. Use/adoption is not evidence of agricultural benefit. Yield, income, water-saving and causal claims require task-specific measurements, a valid comparison and uncertainty reporting.

levels.name: Model and advice quality
levels.decision_question: Given a defined query, evidence envelope, locality, crop/task and time window, does the advice remain factual, bounded, useful and appropriately uncertain?
levels.unit_of_evaluation: versioned advice case with frozen inputs and independent expected outcome
hard_gates: Every material factual claim traces to an available source reference or is labelled unknown/inferred/modelled/forecast.
Unknown, stale and conflicting inputs are never silently promoted to a current verified observation.
No recommendation is emitted as a verified diagnosis, guaranteed result or confirmed external fact beyond its qualified evidence.
Inapplicable, missing or contradictory inputs trigger an explicit abstention, caveat, clarification request or human referral according to the case contract.
Observed results are never relabelled as model predictions, and predictions are never relabelled as observations.

metrics.method: Compare response state, claim provenance, uncertainty disposition and available alternatives to a separately authored oracle.
metrics.target: 100% on the registered synthetic acceptance corpus
metrics.denominator: all registered corpus cases; report every failed case

metrics.method: Independent annotation of claims in a sampled advice output; distinguish unsupported, contradicted, stale and properly qualified claims.
metrics.target: zero unsupported claims in hard-gate synthetic cases; field sample reported with confidence intervals

metrics.method: Check that missing/conflicting/unsafe-to-infer cases result in the registered abstain, clarification or escalation state.
metrics.target: 100% exact disposition match on frozen negative controls

metrics.method: Use Brier score, log loss, CRPS, interval coverage or task-appropriate absolute error only after target, forecast horizon and ground truth are defined and sufficient data exists.
metrics.target: registered by task and data volume before any claim; no universal target
metrics.denominator: eligible predictions with independently observed outcome and disclosed missingness

do_not_collapse: model confidence is not evidence quality
factual correctness is not farmer comprehension
one case result is not causal yield or income impact

levels.name: End-to-end product and user journey
levels.decision_question: Can the farmer or adviser understand, use, recover and complete the task on the actual supported device and channel?
levels.unit_of_evaluation: complete task journey on declared device, language, role and connectivity profile
hard_gates: Local save, awaiting sync, server acknowledgement, offer, accepted quote, booking, provider-reported completion and farmer acceptance remain distinct states.
Every locally acknowledged event survives defined offline/restart/replay fault tests; retries create zero duplicate side effects.
Incomplete, expired, scope-mismatched or withdrawn-capacity offers cannot become confirmed bookings.
Every critical task has visible labels, accessible names, keyboard/focus support and recovery after interruption.
The same request reference survives app, phone/SMS/USSD and human-assisted channels where those paths are supported.

metrics.method: Observe representative users attempting preregistered core tasks without facilitator intervention after the same brief orientation.
metrics.target: >=90% per critical task as an initial product target, not an observed result
metrics.denominator: all eligible participants attempting that task; publish task-level and subgroup results

metrics.method: Measure median and P90 time to save a routine observation, including correction/error rate and omitted fields.
metrics.target: median <30 seconds on a preconfigured farm profile as an initial target
metrics.denominator: successful and failed capture attempts reported separately

metrics.method: Ask users to explain whether a sample item is measured, modelled/forecast, local-only, received, booked, provider-reported complete or farmer-accepted.
metrics.target: >=90% correct distinction in initial comprehension checks
metrics.denominator: all comprehension prompts; report confusion pairs

metrics.method: Inject process kill, reconnection, duplicate/out-of-order events, storage pressure and conflict cases.
metrics.target: zero lost locally acknowledged events, zero duplicate booking/payment/completion effects, zero silent overwrite

do_not_collapse: registrations are not repeated useful use
scheduled jobs are not completed work
browser prototype results are not device/field results

levels.name: Governance, human support, equity and field outcomes
levels.decision_question: Does the service preserve farmer control, accountable advice, fair access and outcomes that can actually be demonstrated?
levels.unit_of_evaluation: whole service process across advice, decisions, action/no-action, follow-up, correction and repair
hard_gates: Declining, deferring, modifying or correcting advice is not treated as user failure or a negative reputation event.
Advice requiring qualified human review can be referred without losing the farmer's place or request reference.
Consent, data purpose, recipient, correction path, export and limits of revoking previously copied information are visible.
Harms, failed requests, no-provider outcomes, no-action, missing follow-up and unresolved cases remain in declared denominators.
A source correction or superseded premise triggers dependent-decision review; prior advice is not silently rewritten.
No public farmer leaderboard, coercive data sharing, automatic adverse decision, procurement/payment, or physical actuation is authorized by the recommendation itself.

metrics.method: Use task observation, interviews and accessible surveys about ability to question, decline, correct, appeal and understand who sees the record.
metrics.target: proposed >=90% success on critical control/comprehension tasks; qualitative findings and subgroup variance reported
metrics.denominator: all participants, including those who choose not to use digital advice

metrics.method: Compare app, phone/SMS, adviser, cooperative and paper-assisted paths by access, fulfillment, time/cost and failure mode where comparable.
metrics.target: no universal numeric threshold before local baseline; disclose coverage and missingness
metrics.denominator: all eligible requests across channels, not only app users

metrics.method: Measure farmer-accepted delivery within the farmer-declared useful window, plus declined, no-provider, cancelled, late, no-show, disputed, rework and unresolved outcomes.
metrics.target: register local baseline and comparison before the pilot; no universal percent improvement claim
metrics.denominator: all eligible requests in the declared window

metrics.method: Measure crop/task-specific outcome with a suitable comparison design and report assumptions, uncertainty, adverse outcomes, and non-participants.
metrics.target: no claim from synthetic tests; numeric thresholds only after local baseline and measurement plan
metrics.denominator: all enrolled eligible units in the registered design, with exclusions and attrition disclosed

do_not_collapse: human mediation is not automatically effective; compare it
observed change is not a causal effect without a suitable design

release_rule: Report the highest level supported by exact, reviewable evidence. Never promote maturity because a workflow is queued, a schema is valid, or synthetic cases pass.
